d:
"Dil Ki Mez" is a soulful track from the Bollywood movie "Merry Christmas," featuring the talented duo of Katrina Kaif and Vijay Sethupathi. The mesmerizing composition is by Pritam, and the vocals are beautifully rendered by Shalmali Kholgade, Lyrics by Varun Grover. This new Hindi song captures the essence of love and celebration
Song Details :
Song Name : Dil Ki Mez
Movie: Merry Christmas
Singer - Shalmali Kholgade
Lyrics - Varun Grover
Music - Pritam
